newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA says 150 mln punts of 10-year bond sold.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA says 150 mln punts of 10-year bond sold.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Tuesday that 150 million punts of the eight percent Treasury bond due 2006 was covered 3.06 times.
The stock, which was sold in a competitive auction achieved an average price of 106.91 to give an annual yield of 6.96 percent, the NTMA said.
It said the highest price achieved was 107.05, to yield 6.95 percent and the lowest accepted price was 106.85 to yield 6.97 percent.
Bidders at the lowest accepted price were allocated 10 percent of the bid at that price, the NTMA said.
The NTMA said 30 million punts of stock was available in a non-competitive auction.
